must_not_flag.summary: after_create_commit is the correct hook for enqueueing; NOT a 'job may run before commit' bug.
perform_bulk with [id, week] arrays (native JSON types) in batches of 1,000 is correct Sidekiq usage, NOT a Redis flood or a bad-argument issue.
create_or_find_by! backed by the unique weekly_digests (user_id, week) index handles the concurrent-duplicate race; NOT a race condition.
Passing the week as an ISO8601 string is correct (native JSON type).
The mailers queue is added to config/sidekiq.yml; NOT an unprocessed queue.
